parallel.verification: The run performed many executable probes and some local module checks, and planned differential testing, but never reached an integrated Node solution acceptance loop.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with workflow killed, no final response, no entrypoint, no complete YAML load/dump pipeline, and 0/70 official tests passed.

serial.implementation: Implemented foundation pieces including errors, pyfloat, values, chars, reader, tokens, and a scanner module, but stopped before parser, constructor, dumper/emitter, and the entrypoint.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The artifact also lacked `/output/test13.mjs`, so there was no runnable submitted entry despite some library files.
serial.verification: Serial gathered extensive black-box probe data and made small module sanity checks, but did not run an integrated evaluator-aligned Node program before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with no final response, no required entrypoint, incomplete YAML implementation, and 0/70 official tests passed after the completed retry evaluation.

Both artifacts missed the required /output/test13.mjs entrypoint, which is enough to explain the shared 0/70 result without attributing a pass/fail difference.
